title: 典雅大學圖書館
style: Real-scale walnut academic library, two-storey bookcases, honed stone inlays, brass rails, textured leather volumes, warm task lights. No faceted plants or colourful toy scenery.

textures.source: Original deterministic mathematical PNG bakes: walnut grain, stone mottling, leather pores, paper fibres
textures.uv: Physical-scale planar projection; intentional tiling at construction seams
textures.floor_atlas: Two 2048px base colour atlases plus constant 256px normal/roughness maps, on two-triangle floors; all maps mipmapped.
